# Vampires
[italic]You awaken, your post life a blur. All you know is you must [color=crimson][bold][italic]feed[/italic][/bold][/color]
You are a [color=crimson]Vampire[/color]. A creature of the night. One which must feed on blood to survive.
## Blood Hunger
Your bloodstream is your source of life. Hunger, thirst, and natural healing are all affected by the amount of blood in your body.
### Feeding
Blood may be collected in a couple ways, but the most important one is by [bold]Feeding[/bold].
To feed, activate the [bold]Feed[/bold] action, then click on the mortal you wish to feed from. This action is very obvious to the victum and anyone nearby, [italic]use it with caution[/italic].
All mortals may be fed from, regardless of their type of blood.
[color=crimson]Red Blood[/color], [color=#7a8bf2]Ammonia Blood[/color], [color=#cd7314]Sap[/color], and even the blood of other undead may be consumed.
Not all your blood must originate from the crew however, you may also feed on [italic]lesser beings[/italic].
Doing so is often a last resort, as lesser beings do not have [bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold]. Also, they just smell bad and taste yucky.
You may also drink blood that has been removed from a body and deposited onto the floor, or some kind of container.
Again, this method of drinking blood will not provide you with any [bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold]. You must [bold]Feed[/bold] in order to accumulate [bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold].
### Blood Essence
[bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold] is what makes a vampire, a vampire. It is the magical life essence you pull out of every mortal when you [bold]Feed[/bold]. While not necessary for survival, [bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold] is what allows you to buy skills and bolster yourself as a creature of the night.
The [bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold] shop provides you with a variety of skills and abilities to augment your body. As you accumulate [bold][color=crimson]Blood Essence[/color][/bold], you will unlock more powerful items in the shop.
### Blood Level
There is no way to know how much blood is currently within your body without using a tool such as a medial scanner.
Although, your hunger and thirst indicators will show up if you start to get dangerously low.
### Natural Healing
Vampires naturally heal from most kinds of damage over time. Given that they are undead creatures, this of course comes at the cost of the blood within their bodies. While naturally healing, your body will drain blood much faster than usual. After a fight, it's often best to chow down on a source of blood, to help refill your reserves.
You may also boost your natural healing with abilities.
Regular medical methods of healing will have zero affect on your body, and will certainly raise eyebrows if you are ever treated by a doctor.
## The Sun
The sun, the incomprehensibly large ball outside the station, direct exposure to it will [bold]burn[/bold] you. Windows throughout the station are [bold]safe[/bold] - as they have protective coating - but step outside and you will feel the burn.
There is a brief grace period before you catch fire, get back inside as soon as possible. Wearing protective gear will not protect you from the sun.
